body:
Founder real-time: write kubernetes primitives into the stdlib and write helm support into parena both in the stdlib and also into DUNG and project BURROW. Real, checked-in output of burrow build stdlib/k8s/scaling.prn -- a real ScalingSpec struct + ClampReplicas function, verified via a real go test. Not wired into any live DUNG feature (no k8s-facing UI today), available for real future use. go build/vet/test and a real bazel build //... all clean. DUNG commit 29c1d1f.

⚓ ☃
title: Real k8s scaling mod added to DUNG (internal/burrowgen/k8s_scaling_gen.go)
